semantics.identity_rule: Each environment has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.class_rule: Environment class/name is descriptive metadata, not the sole identity.
semantics.isolation_rule: Environment boundaries are explicit and do not collapse because resources share a host/network.
semantics.promotion_rule: Promotion between environments is a separate deployment action.
semantics.authority_rule: Access to one environment grants no authority to another.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
